excerpt: Universal Documentation Crawler, High-Density Markdown Extractor & BYOLLM Synthesis Toolkit Built for LLM Context Windows (70%+ Token Noise Reduction): Standard web scrapers dump megabytes of raw HTML, repetitive navigation menus, cookie banners, and script tags that exhaust context windows and dilute model attention. docxtract is specifically engineered to produce compact, high-density, concise Markdown extracts. It preserves code blocks, YAML schemas, markdown tables, and video walkthrough links while eliminating 70%+ of webpage noise—giving your local or cloud LLM pure, high-signal context with zero token bloat. ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Target Documentation / Course Portal │ └────────────────────┬────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ docxtract Crawl Engine │ │ - Cleans boilerplate, nav & footers │ │ - Extracts Mux streams, iframes, video │ │ - Generates structured Markdown files │ └────────────────────┬────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Universal BYOLLM Client Layer │ │ - llama.cpp ( │ │ - Ollama ( │ │ - LM Studio / vLLM / OpenAI / Groq │ └────────────────────┬────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Master Review & Synthesis Engine │ │ - Stage 1: Document Distillation │ │ - Stage 2: Executive Synthesis │ │ - Stage 3: Master Compendium Assembly │ └─────────────────────────────────────────┘ Check out the real-world extraction and synthesis generated from 12 articles of the Warp Software Factory engineering course: 👉 View the 1,220-line Master Technical Review - Raw HTML Size: ~115,000 tokens - docxtract Markdown Size: ~18,000 tokens (84% token reduction) - Synthesis Time: ~2 minutes with local Ollama (llama3.3) Install via PyPI: pip install docxtract-ai Or install from source: git clone cd docxtract pip install -e .docxtract ui Open in your browser. Configure your target URL, pick your model preset, test the endpoint, and run the pipeline! #…
